node.title: Re: Entire Results from R
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Your use of $R->set() is incorrect: to set multiple values, you have to pass an arrayref: $R->set( 'data', ["2016-03-15 13","2016-03-16 23","2016-03-17 06","2016-03-18 15","2016-03-19 08","2016-03-20 21"] ); Then the code works for me.
